chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Yahya ibn Musawir, from Fudayl al-Ghassan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who recites Surah al-Anbiya with love for it, is like one who accompanied all the prophets in the gardens of bliss, and he would be awe-inspiring in the eyes of people during his life in the world.

key_terms.سُورَهَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ: Surah al-Anbiya (The Prophets), the 21st chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Anbiya with love?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith emphasizes the virtue of reciting Surah al-Anbiya with *hubb* (sincere love), promising the reciter a status akin to accompanying all prophets in Paradise. It further highlights a unique worldly benefit: the reciter will command respect and awe (*mahiiban*) among people during their lifetime, reflecting the spiritual gravity of the Surah's narrative of prophetic perseverance.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Yahya b. Musawir from Fudhayl al-Ghassan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
One who recites Surah Anbiya with sincerity to it, would be among the companions of all the prophets in Paradise. While in the world he would carry much prestige and awe among the people.
